title: Run long coding jobs as steps with a persisted handoff
goal: A coding job longer than one step runs each step in a fresh session that starts from a handoff persisted in SQLite
acceptance: A failing-first test across the join (coding job -> runner -> handoff store): a two-step job starts step 2 in a fresh session whose prompt holds step 1 handoff and the full instruction load
The handoff survives a NERV restart between steps and a step never runs twice
privacy: Neutral fixtures and a scratch repository only; no personal data, no paid route.
escalation: A change of gate class, a paid route or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a step loop with a SQLite handoff table, restart handling and a join test. Not a measurement.
